meta.description: Computer Networks undergraduate at NSBM Green University building secure, reliable networks and the web tools around them.

profile.name: Pasindu Dilakshana
profile.headline: I design networks that stay up, and build the tools that keep them honest.
profile.tagline: BSc (Hons) Computer Networks · NSBM Green University
about: I'm Pasindu, a final-year Computer Networks undergraduate at NSBM Green University. I like knowing exactly how a packet gets from a laptop in Matara to a server on the other side of the world, and what can go wrong on the way.

Most of my learning happens in labs: Cisco Packet Tracer topologies, Wireshark captures, VLAN and ACL configs, firewall rules. I pair that with web development, so the networks I design usually come with a dashboard or tool that makes them easier to run.
Right now I'm focused on network security and cloud/SDN, and I'm looking for an internship where I can work on real infrastructure.
profile.currently: Final year at NSBM, going deeper into network security and cloud / SDN.

projects.title: NetFlow
projects.subtitle: Visual VLSM subnet engine
projects.summary: Plans VLSM subnets for a whole site and writes the Cisco IOS config for the L3 switch and edge router.
projects.description: A responsive web app that automates Variable Length Subnet Masking and network planning. Enter departments and host counts; NetFlow sorts them, allocates address blocks with power-of-two logic and capacity guards, and generates production-ready Cisco IOS CLI scripts for Layer 3 switches and edge routers. Built to cut out the manual calculation errors that creep into subnet plans.
highlights: Allocates blocks largest-first with overflow guards
Generates copy-ready IOS config for switches and routers
Visual address-space map of every subnet

projects.title: Network Monitoring Dashboard
projects.subtitle: Python traffic monitor
projects.summary: Watches live traffic with Scapy and SNMP, reports bandwidth and flags anomalies from the CLI.
projects.description: A Python tool that uses Scapy and SNMP to monitor network traffic, produce bandwidth reports, detect anomalies and show the results in a simple CLI dashboard. Alerts are logged to a local database for later review.
highlights: Packet capture with Scapy, device polling with SNMP
Anomaly alerts logged to a local database

projects.title: Mirissa Nature Kayaking

projects.description: A modern, responsive website for a kayaking business in Mirissa. It presents tour packages, booking details and the lagoon, mangrove and wildlife experiences in a clear, mobile-friendly layout, modelled on real guided-tour operators along the southern coast.
highlights: Tour packages with clear booking details
Fully responsive, mobile-first layout

projects.title: Mini SIEM — Traffic Monitor
projects.subtitle: Final-year project · containerised threat detection
projects.summary: Detects SQLi, XSS, brute-force and path-traversal attempts in real time and bans the source IP automatically.
projects.description: A containerised mini SIEM / web-traffic monitoring system. A React + Vite + Tailwind dashboard sits on a Node.js/Express backend with PostgreSQL, all deployed with Docker Compose. It detects SQL injection, XSS, brute-force and path-traversal attempts in real time, runs a honeypot, and automatically bans offending IP addresses.
highlights: Real-time detection of SQLi, XSS, brute force, path traversal
Honeypot endpoints and automatic IP banning
Whole stack ships with one Docker Compose file

projects.title: GuardianAI
projects.subtitle: AI-aware network security platform
projects.summary: Captures traffic, analyses content with an LLM and redacts sensitive data instead of blocking it outright.
projects.description: A network security SaaS concept. A React front end with Three.js visuals talks to a Python FastAPI backend (SQLAlchemy, WebSocket live updates). Scapy captures packets and an LLM performs semantic content analysis, with per-company model training and dynamic data redaction rather than blanket blocking.
highlights: Live packet capture with Scapy + WebSocket updates
Dynamic redaction instead of blanket blocking

projects.title: Ceylon Trails
projects.subtitle: Sri Lanka travel guide & booking platform
projects.summary: Explore Sri Lankan destinations, read community stories and book local guides.
projects.description: A travel guide and booking platform for Sri Lanka built with React, Node.js and MySQL. It includes an Explore section with category and detail pages, a Guides feature with listing, detail and booking pages, and auth-gated Community Stories with JWT and image uploads.
highlights: Explore, Guides and Community Stories features
JWT auth with image uploads
